title: Build Grave Accord with 66 bosses, Crazed forms and class upgrades
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord implements 66 identities (65 ordinary plus one secret), seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. This remains unfinished feature-branch development. PR #14 stays draft and protected main remains separate.

Clerk no longer loses stamp casts on the secondary maps: a bounded connected-floor search replaces its fixed global fallback grid. Full seal footprints avoid masonry, boundaries and lava, and all 289 valid target samples now support both original and distinct appeal sets, fixing 61 failures. Its late phase marks a short patrol before fresh fixed warnings and reopens seal III after its strike; the first phase retains safe seal I. A notch identifies the future-safe seal. Advanced late phases add a fully warned set at three distinct positions with independent strike/safety clocks. Standard health, damage, deadline, intrinsic grade and all existing artwork/music remain.

Constable, Warden, Courier, Ratcatcher and Clerk have individual quality implementations: 5 of 60, 55 remaining, human acceptance open. The roster still needs 85 new ordinary identities. All 66 identities admit Crazed; Insane forces Brutal and Hellish forces Crazed. Existing 2.5x/7.5x projectile budgets, compact arenas, boss header, priority phase bell, reduced-motion-aware transition animation, revival/phase-circle/cover/lava policies and persisted Endless forms remain.

Seven class kits, 21 purchased ability transformations, the optional all-54 skill map, profiles/mastery/cosmetics/remaps, all five modes and bank-safe consented secret are implemented. Known protocol 23 local Practice/profile migration preserves exact form/build history; older bounded migrations remain and online/signed state stays strict. Fifteen-locale help and real owner/observer Clerk replication are covered.

Current validation and retained failures are under reviews/clerk-appeal-2026-10-26/. Read actual HEAD and its own CI; historical green hashes are separate. Automated checks do not establish rendered, native-language, device, listening or final human balance acceptance. Special/action art, human review, active mixed-progression/WAN/endurance/capacity, hosted recovery/rankings and coordinated release remain open. Normal recovery writing stays disabled.

Canonical Wiki remains 18 pages/34 unchanged images, published from exact committed blobs with public image hash checks. All frozen preview roots/processes are preserved. The public protocol 4 Site and immutable protocol 13 Windows archive stay separate. No deployment, main merge, paid provisioning or contest submission is included.
